IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PRIMARILY FOCUSED ON PUBLIC INTEREST RESEARCH AND ADVOCACY ACTIVITIES TO PROMOTE IDEAS, PUBLIC POLICY, AND INVESTMENT NEEDED TO DRIVE ECONOMIC GROWTH IN AMERICA.
IRS990.Desc: THE ORGANIZATION IS ENGAGED IN ADVOCACY, COALITION BUILDING, EDUCATIONAL, AND PUBLIC RELATIONS ACTIVITIES THAT WILL PROVIDE A FORUM AND RESOURCE FOR THE CREATION, DISCUSSION, AND EXECUTION OF INNOVATIVE ECONOMIC POLICY. 2024 PROGRAM SERVICE ACCOMPLISHMENTS ==================================== THE ECONOMIC INNOVATION GROUP (EIG) PUBLISHES ECONOMIC RESEARCH REPORTS AND POLICY ANALYSIS AND MAKES THEM AVAILABLE FOR EDUCATIONAL PURPOSES TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC ON EIG'S WEBSITE: WWW.EIG.ORG. EIG'S KEY ACHIEVEMENTS FOR 2024 INCLUDE: RESEARCH FOCUSED ON ECONOMICALLY DISTRESSED COMMUNITIES AND BOOSTING ECONOMIC DYNAMISM. ------------------------------------------------------------------- EIG PUBLISHED FIVE MAJOR RESEARCH PROJECTS IN 2024, INCLUDING "THE AMERICAN WORKER PROJECT" FEATURING ORIGINAL EIG RESEARCH, PUBLIC OPINION RESEARCH, AND A WIDE-RANGING SERIES OF GUEST ESSAYS; A REIMAGINED VERSION OF OUR FLAGSHIP DISTRESSED COMMUNITIES INDEX WITH A POWERFUL INTERACTIVE MAP THAT ILLUMINATES OUR COUNTRY'S ECONOMIC DIVIDES; A REPORT AND DIGITAL INTERACTIVE TITLED "THE GREAT 'TRANSFER'-MATION" ILLUMINATING THE NATION'S RELIANCE ON INCOME FROM GOVERNMENT; A REPORT TITLED "HEARTLAND VISAS: A POLICY PRIMER A NATIONAL PUBLIC OPINION SURVEY EXPLORING AMERICAN VOTER'S OPINIONS ABOUT HIGH-SKILLED IMMIGRATION; AND A DIGITAL INTERACTIVE MAP TRACKING STATE NONCOMPETE LAWS. POLICIES TO SUPPORT ECONOMICALLY DISTRESSED COMMUNITIES AND BOOST ECONOMIC DYNAMISM. ------------------------------------------------------------------- EIG WORKED WITH CONGRESS ON BIPARTISAN POLICIES, INCLUDING: TO BOOST MOBILITY FOR AMERICAN WORKERS BY RESTRICTING THE USE OF NON-COMPETE AGREEMENTS; TO STRENGTHEN RETIREMENT SECURITY FOR TENS OF MILLIONS OF HARDWORKING AMERICANS THROUGH A LONG-TERM SAVINGS PROGRAM; AND TO BOOST HIGH-SKILLED IMMIGRATION TO COMMUNITIES STRUGGLING WITH DEMOGRAPHIC DECLINE. EIG REGULARLY UPDATES THE OPPORTUNITY ZONES ACTIVITY MAP, AN INTERACTIVE DIGITAL PORTAL HIGHLIGHTING INNOVATIVE INVESTMENTS, FUNDS, AND INITIATIVES LAUNCHED ACROSS THE COUNTRY, AND LEADS A WORKING GROUP OF WIDE-RANGING STAKEHOLDER ORGANIZATIONS TO SHARE OPPORTUNITY ZONES BEST PRACTICES, TECHNICAL INFORMATION, DEVELOPMENTS, AND FACILITATE PEER-TO-PEER LEARNING. EIG WORKED WITH A BIPARTISAN GROUP OF POLICYMAKERS TO IMPROVE THE OPPORTUNITY ZONES POLICY AND ENSURE ITS ALIGNMENT WITH CONGRESSIONAL INTENT. OUTREACH AND EVENTS ------------------------------------------------------------------- EIG EXPANDED ITS REACH WITH THE ACQUISITION AND RELAUNCH OF "THE NEW BAZAAR" PODCAST AND THE "AGGLOMERATIONS" NEWSLETTER. EIG CONVENED AND PARTICIPATED IN ECONOMIC RESEARCH AND POLICY CONVERSATIONS WITH A WIDE ARRAY OF PARTNERS, STAKEHOLDERS, AND POLICYMAKERS THROUGHOUT THE YEAR FOCUSED ON ECONOMIC RESEARCH AND POLICY ISSUES, INCLUDING PLACE BASED POLICY; EFFORTS TO SUPPORT ENTREPRENEURS AND SMALL BUSINESSES; UNDERSTANDING THE CHALLENGES FACED BY AMERICAN WORKERS AND DISTRESSED COMMUNITIES; PROMOTING INCLUSIVE ACCESS TO CAPITAL; SPOTLIGHTING THE IMPORTANCE OF HIGH-SKILLED IMMIGRATION; AND OTHER FOUNDATIONAL ECONOMIC ISSUES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: PART I, LINE 1 - FIRST CLASS TRAVEL:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FIRST CLASS TRAVEL MAY BE APPROVED ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS IF IT'S DETERMINED THAT THE COST IS MINIMAL and it is beneficial to the business purpose of EIG. THE ORGANIZATION DOES NOT TREAT THE FIRST-CLASS TRAVEL COST WHEN PAID AS TAXABLE COMPENSATION.
Bonus for the CEO is subject to board review and approval. Other employee's bonuses are based on performance review on a yearly basis by the CEO.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART III, LINE 1 - ORGANIZATION'S MISSION
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EIG'S MISSION IS TO ADVANCE PUBLIC POLICY SOLUTIONS THAT EMPOWER ENTREPRENEURS AND INVESTORS TO FORGE A MORE DYNAMIC AND ENTREPRENEURIAL ECONOMY THROUGHOUT AMERICA. SPECIFICALLY, EIG IS FOCUSED ON DEVELOPING AND ADVOCATING FOR POLICIES THAT WILL REVITALIZE DISTRESSED COMMUNITIES THROUGH PRIVATE INVESTMENT, SUPPORT ENTREPRENEURSHIP AND THE GROWTH OF NEW BUSINESSES, AND CREATE AN ECOSYSTEM FOR A MORE INNOVATIVE U.S. ECONOMY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The member(s) of the corporation elect(s) the directors.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The member of the corporation has voting rights as provided under Delaware law.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Board has no committees currently. If the Board creates committees, it will document the meetings held or written actions undertaken during the year.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, LINE 11B - FORM 990 REVIEW PROCESS:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS PREPARED BY AN INDEPENDENT CERTIFIED ACCOUNTING FIRM, ENGAGED BY EIG, AND FORWARDS A DRAFT COPY OF THE FORM 990 FOR REVIEW BY THE PRESIDENT, LEGAL COUNSEL AND ACCOUNTING SERVICES. UPON APPROVAL OF THE FORM 990, A COPY IS THEN MADE AVAILABLE TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS PRIOR TO FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, LINE 12C - MONITORING CONFLICTS OF INTERESTS:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY APPLIES TO DIRECTORS, OFFICERS, AND KEY EMPLOYEES. THE POLICY REQUIRES AN ANNUAL DISCLOSURE OF CONFLICTS OF INTEREST AS DESCRIBED IN THE POLICY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, LINE 15A - COMPENSATION REVIEW & APPROVAL:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS APPROVED THE COMPENSATION OF THE PRESIDENT & CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, LINE 19 - OTHER ORGANIZATION DOCUMENTS:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: GOVERNING DOCUMENTS ARE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE NOT MADE AVAILABLE TO PUBLIC.
